question.question: List the ten players taller than 180 cm with the highest mean recorded heading accuracy, highest first. Break mean ties by player API ID.

before:
SELECT p.player_name, p.player_api_id, AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS mean_heading
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id
ORDER BY mean_heading DESC, p.player_api_id ASC
LIMIT 10
